chapter: Favorite bands, advice and family reflections
title: Ben Webster in Denmark
summary: He calls Webster his man when he is in the mood; they played together in Denmark.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Billy Webster, that's my man when you get ready.
What do you mean, when he gets ready?

Exactly what I said. Just exactly. We played together over in Denmark. If he feel like two or three a couple of notes choruses or maybe two bars, you .../and sit there. and then again, moody ...he will play. He was just moody like that but he can play around.
When you played with him, when you all played together, what kind of things did you play? What kind of songs were you all playing?
I know but what songs? The names of any songs, do you remember any?
Did you ever play that on the trombone?
